name: Ballad Bell
description: The tines near the poles and the pickups set back, so it rings as a soft bell under a gentle touch and brightens only when struck hard: for ballads and slow chords.

name: Bright Pop
description: Hard tips, the pickups a little close and the tone wide open: a clear, cutting stage piano for a pop chorus.

name: Dark Room
description: The suitcase's treble all the way down and its bass up, felt-soft hammers: a muffled piano heard through a wall.

name: Driven Suitcase
description: The preamp pushed and the pickups close: the suitcase breaking up on hard chords, with a slow tremolo.

name: Fast Pan
description: The suitcase's tremolo fast and deep: each chord thrown from speaker to speaker.

name: Funk Bark
description: The pickups close and the tines off the poles, with hard hammers: it growls when you dig in and stays round when you play softly.

name: Funk Staccato
description: Hard hammers, the dampers tight and the keys' knock up: short, percussive funk chords that bite.

name: Gospel Bark
description: The pickups close, the bark nearly full and the bass boosted: a big stage piano that roars on hard chords.

name: Hard Tips
description: The hammers at their hardest, the pickups halfway and the dampers set light: a glassy strike whose chords ring on after the keys let go.

name: Init Stage
description: The stage as it comes: the harp straight out of its passive output, no bass boost.

name: Init Suitcase
description: The suitcase as it comes: the harp through the preamp, flat, the tremolo still, the speakers.

name: Jazz Mellow
description: The stage with soft tips and the tone rolled back a little, the bass boosted: round and warm, for comping close voicings.

name: Lo-Fi Dusty
description: The treble rolled off, the keys and dampers loud and a lazy tremolo: a worn, dusty piano for a beat.

name: Long Ring
description: The dampers set light, so each chord rings on after the keys let go, the tines near their poles: an open, sustaining bell.

name: Neo Soul
description: The pickups a little close and the bark up, the bass full and a slow tremolo: warm chords that growl when played harder.

name: Rock Overdrive
description: The suitcase's preamp driven hard, the hardest hammers and the pickups close: a distorted piano for a rock band.

name: Seventies Stage
description: The pickups set halfway, the hammers medium and the bass boosted a little: the full, even stage piano of a seventies soul record.

name: Slow Swirl
description: A slow, deep tremolo and medium hammers: held chords that drift across the speakers.

name: Soft Ballad
description: Medium-soft hammers and a touch of bark through the suitcase, the bass up and a slow, shallow tremolo: warm chords under a singer.

name: Suitcase Vibrato
description: The suitcase's stereo vibrato at a medium speed, panning each chord across the two speakers.
